import cv2, numpy as np
from preprocessor import load_image, _is_homography_sane
from skimage.metrics import structural_similarity as ssim_fn

def test_alignment\(orig_path, gen_path, label\):
    img_o = load_image\(orig_path\)
    img_g = load_image\(gen_path\)
    h, w  = img_o.shape[:2]
    
    go = cv2.cvtColor\(img_o, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY\)
    gg = cv2.cvtColor\(cv2.resize\(img_g, \(w, h\)\), cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY\)
    orb = cv2.ORB_create\(nfeatures=2000\)
    ko, do = orb.detectAndCompute\(go, None\)
    kg, dg = orb.detectAndCompute\(gg, None\)
    bf  = cv2.BFMatcher\(cv2.NORM_HAMMING, crossCheck=False\)
    raw = bf.knnMatch\(dg, do, k=2\)
    good = [m for p in raw if len\(p\)==2 for m,n in [p] if m.distance < 0.70*n.distance]
    if len\(good\) < 25:
        print\(f'{label}: only {len\(good\)} good matches'\)
        return
    src = np.float32\([kg[m.queryIdx].pt for m in good]\).reshape\(-1,1,2\)
    dst = np.float32\([ko[m.trainIdx].pt for m in good]\).reshape\(-1,1,2\)
    H, mask = cv2.findHomography\(src, dst, cv2.RANSAC, 5.0\)
    if H is None:
        print\(f'{label}: homography is None'\)
        return
    inliers = int\(mask.sum\(\)\)
    sane, reason = _is_homography_sane\(H, w, h, w, h, inliers, len\(good\)\)
    scale = np.linalg.det\(H[:2,:2]\)
    U, _, Vt = np.linalg.svd\(H[:2,:2]\)
    R = U@Vt; rot = abs\(np.degrees\(np.arctan2\(R[1,0],R[0,0]\)\)\)
    
    # Apply the warp and compute edge SSIM regardless of sanity
    img_g_r  = cv2.resize\(img_g, \(w, h\)\)
    aligned  = cv2.warpPerspective\(img_g_r, H, \(w, h\)\)
    
    def edge_ssim_img\(a, b\):
        k  = cv2.getStructuringElement\(cv2.MORPH_RECT, \(3,3\)\)
        ag = cv2.cvtColor\(a, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY\)
        bg_ = cv2.cvtColor\(b, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY\)
        ea = cv2.dilate\(cv2.Canny\(cv2.GaussianBlur\(ag,  \(3,3\),0\), 30, 100\), k\)
        eb = cv2.dilate\(cv2.Canny\(cv2.GaussianBlur\(bg_, \(3,3\),0\), 30, 100\), k\)
        s, _ = ssim_fn\(ea, eb, full=True, win_size=7, data_range=255\)
        return s
    
    s_no_align  = edge_ssim_img\(img_o, img_g_r\)
    s_with_warp = edge_ssim_img\(img_o, aligned\)
    print\(f'{label}: matches={len\(good\)} inliers={inliers} rot={rot:.1f}° scale={scale:.3f}  sane={sane} \({reason}\)'\)
    print\(f'       edge_SSIM: no_align={s_no_align:.4f}  with_warp={s_with_warp:.4f}  delta={s_with_warp-s_no_align:+.4f}'\)
